title: Kangra valley — drone film (valley, water, greenery)
author: PB Travel Diaries (original)
changes: Generated for this website and rendered locally as a silent, seamlessly looping 19-second film (1920×1080, H.264, 30 fps) cut from three scenes — a green Himalayan valley with a turquoise river, a mountain stream over mossy boulders, and misty tea terraces. The moves are slow virtual-camera pushes and pans with cross-fades, so there is no hard cut anywhere, including the loop point. No third-party footage or rights are involved; replace it with your own ride footage from the dashboard whenever you like.
